bannedHitCount.description: Count of ban-rule pattern hits over the area source (0 required).

contractOnDisk.description: Area contract exists on disk (contract file / migration / env matrix / token file / spec).

auditClean.description: Deterministic audit over the area reports zero deny hits.

pass.description: True only if bannedHitCount==0 AND contractOnDisk AND auditClean. Fail closed otherwise.
